full_name: Deterministic Ratio-Broadcast Snapshot-Correction Decentralized Gradient Descent (R/C-DGD)

problem.description: n>=2 nodes jointly minimize the equal-weight aggregate; node i can query only f_i.

variable_space.math: Y_k=[y_{1,k}^\top;\ldots;y_{n,k}^\top]^\top,\quad \widehat Y_k=A_kY_k,\quad \widehat y_{i,k}=\sum_{j=1}^n(A_k)_{ij}y_{j,k};\qquad X_k=[x_{1,k}^\top;\ldots;x_{n,k}^\top]\in\R^{n\times d},\quad \bar x_k=\frac1n\mathbf 1^\top X_k,\quad \Delta_k=\max_{i,j}\|x_{i,k}-x_{j,k}\|,\quad g_{i,k}:=\nabla f_i(x_{i,k}),\quad a_k:=\max_i\|x_{i,k+1}-x_{i,k}\|
variable_space.description: Equation (2.1) gives the generic stacked-state row-stochastic mixing; equation (2.2) gives the model stack, arithmetic mean, diameter, local gradient, and one-round displacement.

assumptions.math:
每个 fi : Rd → R 可微且梯度全局 L-Lipschitz：
\[

\]

assumptions.name: time_varying_row_stochastic_network
assumptions.math: 存在整数 B\ge 1 与 a_{\min}\in(0,1]，使每个 A_k\in\R^{n\times n} 行随机，具有正对角元，每个正条目至少为 a_{\min}，且任意连续 B 轮支持图的并图强连通。

assumptions.name: synchronous_exact_real_arithmetic
assumptions.math: \text{通信同步，消息和除法暂按精确实数处理。这个精确算术模型用于先回答算法能否在信息论层面去除行随机偏差；有限精度的影响在第 7 节单独讨论。}

initialization.description: The complete per-round control flow is recorded in steps 1-9: Algorithm 1 computes ell=floor(k/H), r=k mod H, and s=1+(ell mod n), initializes the broadcast lanes only when r=0, decodes and commits only when r=H-1, and queries g_{i,k+1} after the model update.

steps.math: \ell=\lfloor k/H\rfloor,\quad r=k\bmod H,\quad s=1+(\ell\bmod n);\qquad t_\ell=\ell H,\quad \mathcal I_\ell=\{t_\ell,\ldots,t_\ell+H-1\},\quad s_\ell=1+(\ell\bmod n)

main_theorem.statement_math:
定理 4.2 (确定性单循环非凸收敛). 在假设 2.1--2.2 下，若
\[
0<\gamma\le\min\left\{\frac1{4L},\frac1{16LD(C_N+2)}\right\},\tag{4.6}
\]
则对任意允许的拓扑序列和任意 T\ge 1，算法 1 满足
\[
\frac1T\sum_{k=0}^{T-1}\|\nabla f(\bar x_k)\|^2\le\frac{C_{\rm RC}}T,\tag{4.7}
\]
其中
\[
C_{\rm RC}:=C_{\rm pre}+\frac{4(f(\bar x_{K_0})-f_*)}{\gamma}+16(L+\gamma^{-1})^2A_1^2.\tag{4.8}
\]
此外，
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\Delta_k^2<\infty,\qquad \Delta_k\to0.\tag{4.9}
\]
main_theorem.rate: O(1/T) in actual communication rounds T
main_theorem.measure: average squared norm of the arithmetic-mean gradient, together with square-summable and vanishing consensus diameter

proof.description: Restrict all post-prefix norms to the finite horizon [K_0,T) and define the gradient-energy quantity and feedback coefficient used in the theorem proof.
Use the closed disagreement estimate and the drift bound, then apply (a+b)^2 <= 2a^2+2b^2 to split drift energy into transient and gradient-feedback terms.
Bound the loop gain using the step-size condition and gamma L <= 1/4.
Sum the drifted descent inequality from K_0 through T-1 and use the lower bound f_* together with (5.19).
Use the gain bound to move the feedback term to the left-hand side.
Multiply by 4/gamma to obtain the uniform post-prefix energy bound used in the stated constant.
Use the proof sentence that adding the fixed prefix gives (4.7)-(4.8), whose displayed statement is the communication-round average rate with C_RC.
Since the right side of (5.21) is independent of T, the post-prefix gradient energy is uniformly bounded; substitute the disagreement gain to uniformly bound the cumulative squared diameter.
Let T tend to infinity, add the finite prefix, and infer square summability of the full diameter sequence.
Use the contradiction argument for a nonnegative sequence: if Delta_k did not tend to zero, infinitely many terms would exceed an epsilon and the square sum would diverge.

key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{算法 1 满足定义 2.3。每个节点保存 }x_i,g_i,c_i,R_i,\phi_i\text{ 五个 }d\text{ 维向量、标量 }\psi_i\text{ 和常数个计时状态；每轮发送两个 }d\text{ 维向量和一个标量。算法状态为 }O(d)\text{，若计入长度为 }O(n)\text{ 的接收权重行，则总存储为 }O(n+d)\text{；单轮消息为 }2d+1=O(d).
key_lemmas.role: Records the paper's strict single-loop and resource claims for the algorithm object.

key_lemmas.name: uniform_temporal_coverage
key_lemmas.role: Provides a strictly positive common lower bound for every source-to-node entry of each H-round product.

proof.description: Define the temporal-reachability sets S_q from source s and start with S_0={s}; positive self-loops preserve reached nodes.
Strong connectivity of every B-window union gives an edge from any nonempty proper reached set to its complement, so at least one new node is reached per B-round block.
Use the horizon definition H=max{1,(n-1)B} from (2.3) to expose the reachability-block bound needed for the induction.
Induct from one reached source to all n nodes within (n-1)B <= H rounds.
Pad each source-to-terminal temporal path with positive self-loops to obtain exactly H factors, each of weight at least a_min.
Nonnegativity of all other paths preserves the selected path lower bound and yields (5.2).

key_lemmas.role: Justifies the common payload used by every ledger commit.

proof.description: Write the lane initialization in source-column form.
Apply the identical H-round product to vector and scalar lanes.
Use the positive-column bound to show the scalar denominator is positive and the vector lane is the same scalar multiple of z.
Divide coordinate by coordinate to cancel P_is.
Conclude that decoding does not require knowledge of P or a Perron vector.

key_lemmas.name: snapshot_ledger_invariant
key_lemmas.role: Provides the exact arithmetic-average direction and the invariant needed to cancel ledger terms in disagreement bounds.

proof.description: Initialize the invariant from R_i,0=c_i,0=0.
At non-endpoint rounds the ledger variables do not change.
At an endpoint, exact ratio decoding gives one common z; every R_i increases by z and only source s changes its c_s by z.
Expand the endpoint sum to preserve the ledger equality.
Induction gives the invariant for every k, and substituting R=sum c into the direction definition cancels the snapshot terms in the arithmetic average.

key_lemmas.name: direction_identity
key_lemmas.role: Records the exact arithmetic direction average and the cancellation of the common ledger term in direction differences.

proof.description: Define each node direction from the common snapshot ledger and its local current-minus-snapshot innovation.
Expand the cross-node arithmetic average and cancel the snapshot sum against R_k=sum_i c_i,k.
Subtract two node directions so the common R_k/n term vanishes.

key_lemmas.name: uniform_snapshot_age
key_lemmas.role: Converts stale snapshot error into a finite moving sum of recent model displacements.

proof.description: Use the cyclic schedule: a source is sampled every nH rounds and the sample becomes official H rounds later.
Before the next commit, the current snapshot was sampled at q and its age lies in the stated interval.
After the endpoint commit the age drops back to H; after K_0 every source has completed one such submission, so the same bound applies to every source.
Apply gradient Lipschitzness and telescope the model path from the sample time to k.
Replace the sample-time lower index by (k-D)^+ and maximize over i.

key_lemmas.name: dobrushin_diameter_contraction
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{对任意行随机矩阵 }P\text{ 和任意向量组 }Y=[y_1^\top;\ldots;y_n^\top]\text{，有}\quad\max_{i,j}\|(PY)_i-(PY)_j\|\le\delta(P)\max_{r,s}\|y_r-y_s\|,\qquad\delta(P):=\frac12\max_{i,j}\sum_{\ell=1}^n|P_{i\ell}-P_{j\ell}|.\qquad\text{若 }P_{i\ell}\ge\beta\text{ 对所有 }i,\ell\text{ 成立，则 }\delta(P)\le1-n\beta
key_lemmas.role: Supplies the diameter contraction used in the H-step disagreement recursion.

proof.description: Work under the lemma's local hypotheses: P is an arbitrary row-stochastic matrix and Y is an arbitrary vector group.
proof.math: \text{对任意行随机矩阵 }P\text{ 和任意向量组 }Y=[y_1^\top;\ldots;y_n^\top]

proof.description: For two rows define their common mass and normalize the residual row masses.
The common mass cancels from the row difference, leaving (1-alpha) times a difference of two convex combinations of the y_l.
Bound the convex-combination difference by the point-set diameter and identify 1-alpha with the total variation row distance.
Maximize over row pairs to obtain (5.6).
For the second conclusion of the lemma, take the local positive-entry hypothesis for the arbitrary row-stochastic matrix P.
Under the positive-entry hypothesis, each common-mass coordinate is at least beta, so the common mass alpha is at least n beta.
Combine the total-variation identity with the lower bound on alpha to obtain the advertised positive-entry Dobrushin bound.

key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{对 }k\ge K_0\text{，}\quad\Delta_{k+H}\le\rho\Delta_k+2\gamma\sum_{t=k}^{k+H-1}h_t,\qquad\text{并且对任意有限时域 }[K_0,T)\text{，}\quad\norm{\Delta}_{\ell_2[K_0,T)}\le A_0+C_N\gamma\norm{h}_{\ell_2[K_0,T)},\quad C_N=\frac{6H}{n\beta}

Define the stacked direction matrix and matrix products, then expand the model recursion over H rounds.

Each perturbation product is row stochastic and cannot enlarge the direction diameter; combine the perturbations by the triangle inequality.
Obtain the H-step disagreement recursion.
Block the recursion at K_0+mH and define block disagreement and stale-error energies.
Iterate the scalar recursion into initial response plus a geometric convolution.
Apply the l1 geometric-kernel norm and discrete Young convolution inequality to bound the block sequence.

key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{若 }\gamma\text{ 满足式 }(4.6)\text{，则对任意 }T>K_0:\qquad\|h\|_{\ell_2[K_0,T)}\le B_0+2LD\gamma\|\nabla f(\bar x)\|_{\ell_2[K_0,T)},\qquad\|\Delta\|_{\ell_2[K_0,T)}\le A_1+2C_NLD\gamma^2\|\nabla f(\bar x)\|_{\ell_2[K_0,T)}
key_lemmas.role: Closes the endogenous stale-snapshot/disagreement loop on every finite horizon under (4.6).

proof.description: The pre-prefix displacements enter the moving sum for at most D times, so their l2 contribution is bounded by H_0.
Zero-extend post-prefix a outside the finite interval and introduce the length-D all-ones window.
Use the length-D window to bound the post-prefix tail of (5.5) by convolution.
Apply discrete Young's convolution inequality to the all-ones window and the zero-extended movement sequence.
Combine the pre-prefix H0 contribution with the Young-bounded post-prefix tail to obtain the finite-horizon stale-error bound in terms of movement.
Take l2 norms in the pointwise movement lemma over the finite interval.
Substitute the disagreement gain (5.8) into the first movement-norm bound.

Note that all estimates use the same constants for every finite T, so no infinite square-summability is assumed in closing the loop.

key_lemmas.role: Quantifies the row-stochastic arithmetic-mean drift that remains after exact direction averaging.

Combine the two drift components by the triangle inequality.
